description: You are a personality psychology researcher exploring the factor structure of a 25-item personality inventory based on the Big Five Inventory (Revelle, 2010). The dataset BFI25.csv is loaded in jamovi with approximately 2,200 participants who rated 25 personality items (A1-A5, C1-C5, E1-E5, N1-N5, O1-O5) on a 1-6 scale, plus gender and age demographics. You need to conduct an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) to identify the underlying factor structure of the 25 personality items. Use all 25 items (A1 through O5) as the analysis variables — do NOT include gender or age. Extract 5 factors, matching the theoretical Big Five structure. Use oblimin rotation since the personality factors are expected to be correlated. Enable the KMO measure of sampling adequacy and Bartlett's test of sphericity to verify the data is suitable for factor analysis. Save the completed analysis as /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI_FactorAnalysis.omv.
